title: ToolExecutionPayload
description: Payload of a tool-execution card. Unified representation of a single tool / MCP / local action invocation: name, status, args (input), output, and an optional human-readable summary. Both deeppath's ActionSegment and deeppath-agent's ExecutedActionsCard render off this same shape.

name.description: Tool name as exposed to the agent.

summary.description: One-line human summary for the row header.

icon.description: Optional icon hint (lucide name or url).
